fact: As of the diagnostic (figures to December 2022), integrations between non-bank providers and banks, such as SAB and D-Money, were negotiated bilaterally and allowed bank-to-wallet transfers and vice versa; the second phase of the ATS, planned for 2024, was expected to enable systematic interoperability between bank and non-bank payment providers.
title: Diagnostic de l'économie numérique de Djibouti
